title: Folding main does not reconcile a tick the operator closed while the run had it claimed (ha9 rediscovered for a sixth time)
body: ha9 (and qu3) are closed on main at fa9479e7, which every attempt since 14 has had in its base, but the run-side record in .tick/issues/ha9.json still says in_progress — the fold kept the claim-side version. Attempts 11, 14, 15, 16, 17 and now 18 have each independently re-verified and re-reported the same already-done work. The run-side record needs settling from the durable evidence (the closed record on main) so the dispatch loop stops re-dispatching ha9.
